
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/halfcode/p/20084842" title="发布于 2026-05-19 19:44">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">19. 大模型输出乱成渣？3个解析器轻松转成标准列表！</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>做AI应用开发最头疼的事之一，就是大模型的输出永远不按你想要的格式来。明明要求返回一个列表，结果它要么加一堆无关的开场白和结束语，要么格式五花八门，手动写正则处理不仅麻烦，还经常漏各种边界情况。</p>
<p>其实 LangChain 早就为我们准备好了现成的解决方案 ——ListOutputParser 系列解析器，能直接把大模型的自然语言输出，精准转换成程序能直接处理的标准字符串列表。下面这三个最常用的解析器，覆盖了绝大多数列表格式的需求。</p>
<p>视频在这里<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1bKLq6ZEZV/" rel="noopener nofollow">《19. 大模型输出乱成渣？3个解析器轻松转成标准列表！》</a>。</p>
<p><strong>1. CommaSeparatedListOutputParser：简单逗号分隔列表</strong></p>
<p>这是最基础也最常用的解析器，专门处理用英文逗号分隔的连续文本，会自动拆分并去除多余空格，输出干净的字符串列表。适合只需要纯文本条目、不需要额外说明的简单场景。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain_core.prompts <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatPromptTemplate
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain_core.output_parsers <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CommaSeparatedListOutputParser

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 定义通用提示词模板</span>
prompt =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages(
    [
        {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">system</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你是一位有10年经验的资深软件工程师。{format_instructions}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
        {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{new_input}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
    ]
)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建逗号分隔列表解析器</span>
parser =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CommaSeparatedListOutputParser()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取解析器自带的格式指令，自动告诉大模型该怎么输出</span>
format_instructions =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> parser.get_format_instructions()

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 传入参数生成完整提示词</span>
prompt_value =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> prompt.invoke(
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">format_instructions</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: format_instructions,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">new_input</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">请列出5种热门的编程语言。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    }
)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 调用大模型并解析结果</span>
res = llm.invoke(prompt_value, config=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">config)
result </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> parser.invoke(res)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(result)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 输出示例：['Python', 'JavaScript', 'Java', 'C++', 'Go']</span></pre>
</div>
<p><strong>2. MarkdownListOutputParser：带说明的无序列表</strong></p>
<p>如果你的需求不只是纯文本条目，还需要每个条目附带简短说明，那 MarkdownListOutputParser 会更合适。它能自动识别以+、-、*开头的 Markdown 无序列表项，提取内容后还支持保留冒号分隔的键值对格式。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain_core.prompts <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatPromptTemplate
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain_core.output_parsers <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MarkdownListOutputParser

prompt </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages(
    [
        {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">system</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你是一位有10年经验的资深软件工程师。{format_instructions}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
        {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{new_input}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
    ]
)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建Markdown无序列表解析器</span>
parser =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MarkdownListOutputParser()
format_instructions </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> parser.get_format_instructions()

prompt_value </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> prompt.invoke(
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">format_instructions</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: format_instructions,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">new_input</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">请列出5种热门的编程语言，并简要说明每种的特点。</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    }
)

res </span>= llm.invoke(prompt_value, config=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">config)
result </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> parser.invoke(res)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(result)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 输出示例：</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> [</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">   'Python: 语法简洁，生态丰富，适合AI、数据分析和后端开发',</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">   'JavaScript: 前端开发必备，也可通过Node.js做后端',</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">   'Java: 跨平台性好，广泛用于企业级应用开发',</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">   'C++: 性能极高，适合游戏引擎、操作系统等底层开发',</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">   'Go: 天生支持并发，部署简单，适合云原生应用'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ]</span></pre>
</div>
<p><strong>3. NumberedListOutputParser：有序步骤列表</strong></p>
<p>对于需要按顺序呈现的内容，比如操作步骤、流程说明，NumberedListOutputParser 是最佳选择。它会精准匹配以 “阿拉伯数字 + 英文句点” 开头的有序列表，自动剥离编号前缀，同时严格保持原有的顺序不变。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain_core.prompts <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatPromptTemplate
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> langchain_core.output_parsers <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> NumberedListOutputParser

prompt </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages(
    [
        {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">system</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">你是一位有10年经验的资深软件工程师。{format_instructions}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">},
        {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">role</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">user</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">content</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{new_input}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">}
    ]
)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建有序列表解析器</span>
parser =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> NumberedListOutputParser()
format_instructions </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> parser.get_format_instructions()

prompt_value </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> prompt.invoke(
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">format_instructions</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: format_instructions,
        </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">new_input</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">请列出程序员从早上到公司到下班离开的完整上班步骤</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    }
)

res </span>= llm.invoke(prompt_value, config=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">config)
result </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> parser.invoke(res)

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 可以重新编号输出，也可以直接用列表做后续逻辑处理</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> step_num, step_content <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> enumerate(result, 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{step_num}. {step_content}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>这三个解析器的核心优势在于，它们会自动生成标准化的格式指令传给大模型，同时内置了完善的容错处理，能应对大模型输出的各种小偏差。不用再写冗长复杂的正则表达式，也不用反复调整提示词去约束输出格式，几行代码就能让大模型的输出直接接入业务逻辑，大幅提升开发效率。</p>

</div>
